title: flucoma
description: `flucoma` is a welcome and configuration patch for Fluid Corpus Manipulation, providing access to its object overview, documentation, tutorials, and examples. To make FluCoMa objects available, add the package folder to Pd’s search path with `declare -path FluidCorpusManipulation`; additional library objects require `declare -lib fluid_libmanipulation`, and both declarations can be combined.
